name: logic_bench_find_dag_40_med
description: A task from the LogicBench suite that tests a model's ability to identify or construct a directed acyclic graph (DAG) instance under specified constraints. Inputs typically describe nodes/constraints and the model must output a correct DAG representation. The benchmark measures structured logical reasoning and graph-construction correctness.
reputation: Part of the LogicBench family of synthetic logical-reasoning tasks; used in research probing structured reasoning capabilities of language models.
